verses.pali: “So vata, bhikkhave, bhikkhu agāravo appatisso asabhāgavuttiko ‘sabrahmacārīsu ābhisamācārikaṁ dhammaṁ paripūressatī’ti netaṁ ṭhānaṁ vijjati.
verses.english: “Mendicants, it is quite impossible for a disrespectful and irreverent mendicant with incompatible lifestyle to fulfill the practice dealing with supplementary regulations regarding their spiritual companions.

verses.pali: ‘Ābhisamācārikaṁ dhammaṁ aparipūretvā sekhaṁ dhammaṁ paripūressatī’ti netaṁ ṭhānaṁ vijjati.
verses.english: Without fulfilling the practice dealing with supplementary regulations, it’s impossible to fulfill the practice of a trainee.

verses.pali: ‘Sekhaṁ dhammaṁ aparipūretvā sīlāni paripūressatī’ti netaṁ ṭhānaṁ vijjati.
verses.english: Without fulfilling the practice of a trainee, it’s impossible to fulfill ethics.

verses.pali: ‘Sīlāni aparipūretvā sammādiṭṭhiṁ paripūressatī’ti netaṁ ṭhānaṁ vijjati.
verses.english: Without fulfilling ethics, it’s impossible to fulfill right view.

verses.pali: ‘Sammādiṭṭhiṁ aparipūretvā sammāsamādhiṁ paripūressatī’ti netaṁ ṭhānaṁ vijjati.
verses.english: Without fulfilling right view, it’s impossible to fulfill right immersion.

verses.pali: So vata, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sagāravo sappatisso sabhāgavuttiko ‘sabrahmacārīsu ābhisamācārikaṁ dhammaṁ paripūressatī’ti ṭhānametaṁ vijjati.
verses.english: But it is quite possible for a respectful and reverent mendicant with compatible lifestyle to fulfill the practice dealing with supplementary regulations regarding their spiritual companions.

verses.pali: ‘Ābhisamācārikaṁ dhammaṁ paripūretvā sekhaṁ dhammaṁ paripūressatī’ti ṭhānametaṁ vijjati.
verses.english: Having fulfilled the practice dealing with supplementary regulations, it’s possible to fulfill the practice of a trainee.

verses.pali: ‘Sekhaṁ dhammaṁ paripūretvā sīlāni paripūressatī’ti ṭhānametaṁ vijjati.
verses.english: Having fulfilled the practice of a trainee, it’s possible to fulfill ethics.
Having fulfilled ethics, it’s possible to fulfill right view.
Having fulfilled right view, it’s possible to fulfill right immersion.”
